blurb: Afro house, deep house and amapiano from a Denver DJ who trained in Indian classical music and plays live tabla over his own set when you book it, so there's a musician on the floor as well as a DJ. Brown Liquor has played Black Box, Larimer Lounge and Your Mom's House in Denver and club nights in Hong Kong, and books for after-parties, holiday parties, weddings and birthdays across Colorado.

identity: He trained in Indian classical music on the tabla, a pair of hand drums, and he brings them with him. Played over the records, they give the crowd a musician to watch as well as a DJ, and the same set works without them when you book the DJ on his own.

In Denver he's played Your Mom's House six times, Larimer Lounge three times, Black Box and Beacon. Away from Colorado he's played Chicago, San Francisco, San Diego and Hong Kong, on bills with Night Tales, Win and Woo and Born Dirty.

He can play the warm-up while a crowd is still arriving and talking, the peak of the night once the floor is full, or one long set that covers both. He's based in Denver and takes dates across Colorado.
_entity_note: Instagram is the only profile he gave (his first email, 2026-11-02); he has no site and no channel of his own. Person, with the stage name, since a DJ alias is one person.
_gear_note: 2026-11-02, his last email in the thread: after Daniel asked for quotes with the equipment handled by the act (decks plus a small PA, about one 1,000W speaker or a 500W stereo pair, as the baseline), he sent all-inclusive rates covering his own DJ decks, mixer, cables, the small PA, the tabla microphone, setup and breakdown. Bigger sound, major holidays and unusually large events he quotes per event; travel outside the Denver metro separately. He also gave written permission for the photos, videos and materials and to be listed.
